payout_quote: Compensation for services as an election official of Henrico County ranges from $225.00 to $300.00 per election.
steps: Confirm you are a U.S. citizen, Virginia resident, 18 by the next general election, and a qualified voter of the Commonwealth
Complete the online application form for Officer of Election on the Henrico County Registrar page
File an oath with the General Registrar's office and attend required pre-election training (held about two weeks before each election)
Serve at your assigned precinct of Henrico County's 93 voting precincts on election day
catches: Must be able to serve the entire time the polls are open on election day
Work as either a Republican or Democrat party representative
Must provide your own transportation to and from the polls
Pay rate depends on the position fulfilled
Training may be required before each election
biggest_catch: Full-day commitment only: you must serve the entire time the polls are open, reporting at 5:00 A.M. and staying until results are reported after the 7:00 P.M. close.
eligibility: U.S. citizen; Virginia resident; 18 years old by next general election; qualified voter of the Commonwealth; work as Republican or Democrat; voting rights restored if felon
timing: Report at 5:00 A.M.; polls open 6:00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M.; remain until results are reported to the Henrico County Electoral Board after polls close at 7:00 P.M.
